title: Gate evidence staging on cached diff hygiene
failure_signature: The first exact staging pass carried conversion warnings and two extra EOF blank lines, causing cached diff hygiene to fail.
candidate_workaround: Retain the warnings, remove only reported whitespace defects, restage, and require zero cached-diff and staged-review issues.
recurrence_guard: A successful git add is not evidence-stage acceptance; cached diff hygiene and exact staged-blob review must both pass.
rollback: Leave the commit unmade, retain the failed index receipt, and restage only after bounded whitespace repair.
protected_gates: No commit from failed diff hygiene
scope_boundary: This method validates evidence-index hygiene only and does not prove newline portability, scientific correctness, or independent reproduction.
